# pdf2htmlEX viewer chrome

Shared viewer assets copied from the MarkupServer pdf2htmlEX install
(`/opt/pdf2htmlEX/usr/local/share/pdf2htmlEX/`, AppImage v0.18.8.rc1).

Served from `public/vendor/pdf2htmlEX/` so `MarkupDocumentViewer` can load them
into the document iframe. Keep `src/vendor/pdf2htmlEX/` in sync as the source copy.
